transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Services. My name is Jordan. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi Jordan, I'm calling because there's some money from a store that was supposed to go back on my card, but it never arrived.
Agent: I can look into that for you. May I have your full name and the billing zip code on the account?
Customer: Sure, my name is Aldo Fenwick, and the zip code is 97201.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Fenwick. Which store was this with, and what were the details of the purchase?
Customer: It was Clearview TV Outlet. I bought a television there, and then the price went down right after.
Agent: Okay, and what did the store say they would do regarding that price drop?
Customer: Well, I went in and talked to them, and they promised a $50 price adjustment on August 26, 2026.
Agent: And was that $50.00 supposed to be sent back directly to your card?
Customer: Yes, exactly. They swiped the card and told me $50.00 would be put right back on it.
Agent: Have you seen any sign of that money showing up on your account yet?
Customer: No, I've checked my last two statements now, and there's nothing there from them.
Agent: Did Clearview TV Outlet give you any paperwork or an email about this?
Customer: Yes, I got an email receipt showing the fifty dollar difference they promised to return.
Agent: All right. So to make sure I have the full picture, Clearview TV Outlet agreed on August 26, 2026, to return $50.00 to your card for a price adjustment on a television, but two statements have passed and that $50.00 has never appeared.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly what happened.
